hero.description: I build APIs, data pipelines and the cloud infrastructure behind them, with a focus on making them secure, observable and easy to maintain. I currently work remotely for a UK-based tech company.

about.title: From IT support to backend, with security always in mind
paragraphs: I'm a Backend & Security Engineer based in Entre Ríos, Argentina. I work remotely with teams in other countries, in Spanish and English.

I started out fixing hardware, networks and security incidents for real clients. That left me with a habit: thinking about what happens after the deploy. Today I design backend services, data pipelines and cloud infrastructure, and I make sure data is correct, protected and auditable.
I like to understand the whole problem before writing code, document what I do, and leave systems better than I found them.

education.title: Higher Technical Degree in Software Analysis and Development

items.summary: I work on the backend, data and security of a SaaS platform in production. My focus is making data reliable, keeping the system auditable, and giving the team visibility into what's happening in production.
highlights: Designed and built a data warehouse on AWS, with dbt models and infrastructure as code in Terraform.
Python ETL pipelines that integrate external sources, with validation and quality checks at every stage.
Data integrity and auditing: change traceability, validation rules and access control.
Observability for the core API to detect and diagnose issues before they reach users.
Remote work in English with a distributed team, with 130+ pull requests this year.

items.summary: Built end-to-end features for a platform where labels and artists send promos, manage releases and collect feedback.
highlights: NestJS backend with TypeScript, dependency injection and Firebase Auth for identity management.
File uploads with signed URLs, analytics dashboards and a social media content generator.
Led the migration from GCP to AWS (S3, SQS, Elastic Beanstalk) and Cloudflare (Pages, R2) with Terraform and Docker.
Scripts to automate deployments that used to be manual.

items.summary: Technical support for the Plex 25 pharmacy management system for healthcare clients, with proactive monitoring to keep operations running.
Infrastructure maintenance and security for institutions and small businesses.
highlights: Contained and cleaned up a critical malware incident, restoring the integrity of the environment.
Implemented and managed SSL/HTTPS certificates and dynamic DNS for stable remote access.
LAN networks, firewalls and backup and recovery plans on Windows and Linux.
